entries.topic: Transfer thinking and displacement before 14 May 1948 (Nov 2026)

claims.text: Weitz, JNF land department from 1932; diary 20 Dec 1940: 'There is no room in Palestine for these two peoples'; 1948 'Transfer Committee' (Weitz, Danin, Sasson) per Masalha and Morris; Karsh: never established.
Labour Party conference, Dec 1944: 'Let the Arabs be encouraged to move out of Palestine, as the Jews move in'; reversed in office from Oct 1945.
Arab League cable, 15 May 1948: 'over a quarter of a million' compelled to leave their homes.

sources.label: Wikipedia (via Wikiwand), 'Yosef Weitz' (citing his diary, Masalha, Morris and Karsh)
Jon Kimche, 'British Labor's Turnabout on Zionism', Commentary
